trigger: fetch/URLSession fails before any HTTP response (offline, refused, DNS)
title: Can't reach the server
message: We couldn't connect to the music server. Check that it is running and that you are online, then try again.

trigger: request exceeds the client timeout (15 s) with no response
title: The server is taking too long
message: The server didn't answer in time. Your library is still here. Try again in a moment.

trigger: HTTP 401 while loading the library (no valid token yet)
title: Access token needed
message: This server needs an access token before it will share music. Enter the token to continue.

trigger: HTTP 401 after the library was loaded (token changed or expired)
title: Please sign in again
message: The server no longer accepts your token. Enter it again to keep listening. Your queue and position are kept.

trigger: HTTP 404 on stream or metadata for a track
title: Track unavailable
message: This track is no longer on the server, so we can't play it. You can skip to the next one.

trigger: HTTP 416 on a Range request (seek past the end or stale length)
title: Couldn't jump to that spot
message: We couldn't seek to that point in the track. Playback restarts from where you were.

title: The server had a problem
message: Something went wrong on the server's side. Nothing you did caused it. Try again shortly.

trigger: response body cannot be parsed (JSON decode failure, wrong shape)
title: Unexpected reply from the server
message: The server sent something we couldn't read. Trying again may help; if not, the server may need an update.

trigger: MediaError code 3/4, AVPlayerItem failed with decode/format error, ExoPlayer decoder error
title: This track won't play
message: We couldn't play this track's audio. Your queue is unchanged, so you can skip to the next track.

trigger: playback buffer empty for more than 5 s while the network is reachable
title: Still loading the music
message: The music is taking a while to load. We'll keep trying and resume from the same spot.

trigger: network error or offline event while a track is streaming
title: Connection lost
message: Playback paused because the connection dropped. We'll resume from the same spot when you're back online.

trigger: cover image request fails for any reason
title: Cover art unavailable
message: Cover art couldn't be loaded. A placeholder is shown instead.

trigger: library request succeeds with zero tracks (not an error)
title: No music yet
message: The library is empty. Add some tracks on the server and refresh.

trigger: any failure that matches no other code
title: Something went wrong
message: Something unexpected happened. Try again, and your library and queue will stay as they are.
